% A test for tex8web: ntheorem's theorems, which can't share a document with
% amsthm's. Numbered ones, one with a note, get a link at their head; an
% unnumbered one (\newtheorem*) doesn't; a \ref leads to the numbered one's
% head.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[thmmarks]{ntheorem}
\theorembodyfont{\itshape}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\theorembodyfont{\upshape}
\newtheorem*{remark}{Remark}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{theorem}\label{thm:one}A numbered theorem.\end{theorem}
\begin{theorem}[A note]Another, unlabelled.\end{theorem}
\begin{remark}An unnumbered remark.\end{remark}
Theorem~\ref{thm:one} is numbered.
\end{document}
